value.rationale: Determines a natural full similarity/dynamical invariant for two distinguished local defects on all hypercubes of dimension at least three. The adjacency threshold sharply changes invertibility, periods and stopping-time distributions, whereas every nonadjacent Hamming distance produces the same class; the global effect of a minimal local change is mathematically motivated and non-routine.
